# Scribble UI

> Hand-drawn React components where every stroke carries meaning. Real pen
> physics (curvature-dependent velocity, pen-up flights, speed-dependent ink
> width), seeded deterministic imperfection (SSR-safe), distributed as
> copy-paste source via a shadcn-compatible registry.

Stack: React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind (any v4 setup) + a zero-dependency
ink engine (@scribbleui/engine). Text components add @scribbleui/text
(centerline .hand stroke fonts derived from the public-domain Hershey
collection). A few overlay components use motion.

## Install

- `npx scribbleui add button` — or with the shadcn CLI:
  `npx shadcn@latest add https://scribbleui.com/r/button.json`
- Runtime deps land in your package.json; component source lands in your repo.
- Add the ink tokens (CSS custom properties) via `npx scribbleui init`.

Docs site: sidebar of all components; every component page has live preview,
variants, a customize panel, usage/install tabs, a props table, and a
"copy for AI" button that yields exactly this kind of markdown.

## Principles

1. Strokes mean something: the circle around a radio option IS the selection;
   the scratch-out IS the number change. No decorative wobble.
2. Pen physics, not path tricks: velocity follows a two-thirds-power-law
   flavor; pens lift and fly between strokes; width comes from speed.
3. Seeded imperfection: same seed, same ink — SSR, hydration and screenshot
   tests agree. `seed` is a prop on everything.
4. One signature move per component, 150–400ms, reduced-motion renders the
   final drawn state instantly. Real text stays in the DOM; ink is aria-hidden.

## Components (38)

Ink & Text: handwritten, annotate, arrow-art, scribble-arrow, scratch-number, margin-note
Forms: button, input, textarea, checkbox, radio, switch, slider, select
Navigation: tabs, sidebar, breadcrumb, dock
Overlays: tooltip, popover, modal, drawer, context-menu
Feedback: toast, badge, loader, progress, skeleton
Surfaces: card, accordion, table, separator, avatar, kbd, marquee
Delight: theme-toggle, empty-state, stickman
Surfaces also: blockquote

Registry index: https://scribbleui.com/r/registry.json
Each component: https://scribbleui.com/r/<name>.json
